chapters.title: StockReef, live on Robinhood Chain testnet
chapters.speaker: Aryan
phrases: This is StockReef, live on Robinhood Chain testnet.
It lets you borrow dollars against tokenized Tesla stock,
and it manages the moment other lenders ignore,
when the stock market closes for the weekend.

chapters.title: What breaks when Wall Street closes
chapters.speaker: Aryan
phrases: Tesla's token trades all weekend, but its real price stops at four on Friday.
One Monday in sixteen opens five percent or more away,
and a loan can't react in between.

chapters.title: Lending today ignores the clock
chapters.speaker: Aryan
phrases: Three billion dollars of stock RWAs are on chain, but lending against them is tiny,
because markets keep one fixed limit around the clock.
In a deep weekend gap, that costs lenders four times more.

chapters.title: A real loan book on testnet
chapters.speaker: Awaan
phrases: I connect the borrower's wallet to the live app on testnet,
and the portfolio shows the whole loan and every protection.
Lenders see a real book of four loans and what each is worth,
and operations lists who needs to act before the close.

chapters.title: Two hours before the bell
chapters.speaker: Awaan
phrases: Two hours before the bell, StockReef starts lowering the safe limit,
from eighty percent down to seventy.
At quarter past three this loan is just over the line,
so the app shows exactly what to do, repay seven dollars thirty four by half past three.

chapters.title: Pay it down before the bell
chapters.speaker: Awaan
phrases: This borrower funded a repayment buffer in advance.
I run it, and a real transaction goes to Robinhood Chain.
Confirmed in seconds, the debt drops from seventy two to sixty five dollars.
The loan is back under the line, with nothing sold and no penalty paid.
And here's the receipt on the Robinhood Chain explorer.

chapters.title: A partial trim, not a wipe-out
chapters.speaker: Awaan
phrases: Ben has no buffer, and at seventy four percent he's over the line.
A liquidator trims part of his loan now, for a small two percent bonus.
His debt falls to eighteen dollars, and the loan stays open at sixty five percent.
Both transactions are on chain.

chapters.title: Closed for the weekend, reopened with care
chapters.speaker: Aryan
phrases: At four the market closes and new borrowing locks.
Paying down still works, so the borrower repays a dollar on chain.
On Monday a fresh price of three seventy six arrives,
but nothing trusts it until it's admitted five minutes after the open.
Cleo's loan crossed seventy percent at the new price,
so a recovery trim brings it back before new credit returns.

chapters.title: Lenders see losses before they happen
chapters.speaker: Aryan
phrases: Lenders are protected by design.
Their shares always reflect what the loans can really recover,
so if Tesla fell to two twenty, the shortfall shows today and is shared fairly.
Nobody finds it after a default.

chapters.title: When the price feed goes quiet
chapters.speaker: Awaan
phrases: Now a deliberate failure.
The price feed has been quiet for two minutes.
I try to borrow one dollar,
and the contract refuses the stale price before my wallet is even asked to sign.

chapters.title: Built to hold up
chapters.speaker: Awaan
phrases: Under the app, five hundred thirty one tests run in about a minute,
covering the risky paths with fuzz, property and invariant suites.
Four more run against Robinhood Chain mainnet.

chapters.title: Next for StockReef
chapters.speaker: Aryan
phrases: Next for StockReef, we calibrate the limits against real gaps,
add stock RWAs one market at a time,
get audited, and launch on Robinhood Chain mainnet.
StockReef: borrow against your stocks, safely, even when the market is closed.
